subject: Trial extension and promotional credit proposal for Acme Analytics

Subject: Trial extension and promotional credit proposal for Acme Analytics

Hi Joseph,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really enjoyed the discussion about reducing inference costs for your interactive analytics features. Per our conversation, I talked to the team about an end-of-quarter close incentive that would make it easy for Acme to finish evaluation and ramp into production in July.

Short proposal:
- 3 weeks of extended trial (no usage caps) + a one-time $10,000 promotional credit applied to first invoice if you sign an annual commitment by July 2.
- Includes a lightweight migration kick-off and one performance tuning session from our Delivery team.

Attached is a short proposal (Acme_TrialProposal_2026-06-25.pdf) with the scope and acceptance criteria. If you can confirm procurement contact and that this approach looks ok, I can route the promotional credit through our finance team for sign-off and push a DocuSign SOW.

I want to be explicit: this is a one-time promotional credit tied to an annual commitment signed before the quarter closes. If that timing doesn't work, we can discuss other structures, but this is the option that gives the fastest path to production for your team.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync today to finalize procurement details?

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Aditya,

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the proposal — this is exactly the kind of flexibility we were hoping for given our internal timelines. The $10k credit plus a scoped kick-off looks reasonable.

I can set up a quick call with our procurement lead (copied) if you want to walk through it. We are targeting a purchase decision by EOD July 1.

Thanks — talk soon.
